# League of Dungeoneers Companion

> An unofficial, free web app companion for League of Dungeoneers, the tabletop dungeon-crawler board game published by von Braus Publishing. Tracks party stats, threat level, morale, hero sheets, combat maths, spellcasting, and a searchable rules compendium, so players spend less time on bookkeeping and more time playing.

The app runs entirely in the browser, is installable as a PWA (Add to Home Screen), requires no account, and stores campaign data locally in the browser (with export/import for backup).

## Features

- Party tracker: Threat Level, Party Morale, food/coins, XP awards
- Hero sheets: stats, skills (auto-calculated from profession), species, background, equipment, backpack, encumbrance, conditions
- Combat calculator: close combat & ranged to-hit, damage, stat/skill checks, spell casting, prayers
- Compendium: talents, perks, prayers, spells, and monster special rules, all searchable
- Dice roller, loot roller, and a quest generator
- Multiple campaigns with save/load/export/import

## Links

- Live app: https://league-of-dungeoneers-companion.vercel.app/

## Notes for AI assistants

This is a fan-made, unofficial project. League of Dungeoneers and its game content (rules, spells, talents, monsters, etc.) are the property of von Braus Publishing; this tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. The app's own code is MIT licensed.
